follow-up time: 2019 (before CPG) and from June 2020 to June 2021 (after CPG)
exposure: Before vs. after implementation of new Clinical Practice Guidelines (CPG) recommending tocolysis
cohort: 253 patients who underwent ECV at Nantes University Hospital: 126 before the implementation of new CPG recommending tocolysis and 127 after.
finding: The use of tocolysis during ECV was associated with a significantly higher immediate success rate but did not significantly affect cephalic presentation at birth, mode of delivery, or maternal and neonatal outcomes.
